title: Town D · lower pitch and lower octave comparison

provenance.description: Original mechanical synthesis refining the user's preferred Town D. All candidates preserve D's motor timing, paired-tone ratio, harmonics, rotation swell and seeded air texture. No recorded samples appear in the outputs.
provenance.status: Town G is user-selected for now (2026-10-11). D/F remain comparison alternatives; production loop/end behavior, game integration and device acceptance remain pending.

selection.Town: G selected for now: lower pitch plus quiet lower octave

candidates.label: D · current preferred reference
candidates.intent: The current 600/720 Hz candidate, retained for a direct level-matched comparison.

candidates.label: F · modestly lower pitch
candidates.intent: Both held tones lowered 10 percent to 540/648 Hz (about 1.8 semitones); the rest of D's character is retained.

candidates.label: G · lower pitch with quiet lower octave
candidates.intent: The same 540/648 Hz tones as F, plus quiet 270/324 Hz components for more low body without changing the two-tone identity.
